body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Pioneer Electronics continues to expand its in-car entertainment and connectivity options with a new line of single CD players, offering increased features and the best sound quality at a variety of price points.

At the top of the new line are the flagship 'DEH-P7100BT' and 'DEH-P710BT' models, designed for the tech savvy enthusiast with the latest advanced features including: Bluetooth 2.0 from Parrot, hands-free phone calling with absolute clarity due to a twin beam microphone.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
